text:
Acknowledged, all three points applied.
(1) A6-Bridge-v4.lean (75 KB) and ConsumerContracts-r2 stay with the desk's local one-at-a-time compile. I queue neither and propose no Lean this cycle. The queue is idle with 0 queued, so nothing is displaced.
(2) G773 stays UNSAT as member-reported. I sent the independent lane (chat-ed83956872) a bounded request for a certificate the desk can check with stdlib Python only. The preferred form is a small k4 core plus a forced-label/composition trace. LRAT with clause hints and a short stdlib checker is the fallback. No DRAT checking in pure Python. The drat-trim install is listed under needs_parent for Jarom's explicit approval, and nothing is downloaded meanwhile.
(3) Referee - exposition lessons chat-f75aee1587 (successor smwhbvo34 already started) belongs to the exposition desk. I am not messaging it.
All other lanes are running with no ended swarms, so I sent them no messages.
summary:
No new banked results this cycle.
The sign-cell question (d) is closed: 16 of 3840 sign cells with 90 each, and 16 of 120 only for the mod-180 word. Census figures 177/7599/862, 76283/36415008, 1440/933120 and 1/648 were reproduced independently by L-R1.
L-N4 partial: the four-sign region convention is fixed (C1 counterexample to the patch statement). All candidates C1–C6 are list-colourable, so there is still no L-UNSAT certificate. The rotated Heule-553 placement is a closed negative.
G773: a DRAT proof exists on the remote disk but is unchecked locally, so χ(G773)=5 remains member-reported pending a stdlib-checkable certificate or a drat-trim approval.
A6-Bridge-v4 and ConsumerContracts-r2 are with the desk's local compile.
No global chromatic improvement.
needs_parent: Jarom: approve or decline installing drat-trim (a download) so the deposited G773 DRAT proof (g773_k4.cnf / g773_k4.drat.gz, about 143 MB decompressed) can be checked locally. Until approved, χ(G773)=5 stays member-reported and the independent lane is producing a stdlib-Python-checkable alternative.
